Flag body-clock shifts for each team and game

Source: R/time_zone.R
flag_time_zone_shifts.Rd

Computes the signed time-zone shift a team experiences relative to its home time zone, using the scheduled kickoff instant. The same instant is converted to each team's home zone and the venue zone, so daylight-saving changes are handled by the operating system's time-zone database.

Usage

flag_time_zone_shifts(
  schedule,
  team_home = nfl_airports,
  venues = nfl_stadiums,
  default_kickoff = "13:00",
  east_weight = 1,
  west_weight = 0.5
)

Arguments

schedule

A data frame with game_id, gameday, home_team, and away_team. gametime is used when present; otherwise default_kickoff is assumed. stadium_id, location, season, and week are carried through when present.

team_home

Team home-base lookup with team and time_zone. Defaults to nfl_airports.

venues

Venue lookup with stadium_id and time_zone. Defaults to nfl_stadiums.

default_kickoff

Kickoff time in U.S. Eastern time used when gametime is absent or missing. Defaults to "13:00".

east_weight

Multiplier for eastward clock shifts. Defaults to 1.

west_weight

Multiplier for westward clock shifts. Defaults to 0.5, since eastward shifts are usually harder on the body clock.

Value

A tibble with one row per team per game: game_id, season, week, gameday, team, opponent, is_home, location, venue, team_time_zone, venue_time_zone, kickoff_utc, kickoff_home_local, kickoff_venue_local, tz_shift_hours, tz_direction, eastward, westward, and body_clock_penalty. Positive tz_shift_hours means the team travels east.

Details

A normal home game has zero shift. Neutral-site games can shift the designated home team too, because it is playing away from its home time zone. The body-clock penalty is east_weight * max(shift, 0) + west_weight * max(-shift, 0).

Examples

games <- subset(nfl_schedules_sample, game_id == "2024_02_SEA_NE")
shifts <- flag_time_zone_shifts(games)
shifts[, c("team", "team_time_zone", "venue_time_zone", "tz_shift_hours")]
#> # A tibble: 2 x 4
#>   team  team_time_zone      venue_time_zone  tz_shift_hours
#>   <chr> <chr>               <chr>                     <dbl>
#> 1 NE    America/New_York    America/New_York              0
#> 2 SEA   America/Los_Angeles America/New_York              3
